name: followproof
description: MCP connector for Followproof: check whether an Instagram, TikTok or YouTube creator's audience is real, compare creators and find new ones by niche.
long_description: Vet influencers before you pay them. check_creator gives an audience quality score with the signals behind it, engagement against same-size accounts, posting cadence and an estimated sponsored-post rate. get_creator_report adds peers, sponsored posts and earnings; compare_creators puts finalists side by side; search_creators finds creators by niche, size and country; saved lists keep your shortlist. Everything uses your Followproof plan's allowance.
